idle_gate: memory<500MiB and utilization<5% and no compute PID, double check after index+UUID locks
new_wrapper_changes: Inherit native.Controller lifecycle; replace optimizer builder and batch method with history_response stepper.
Use exact two ordinary CE gradient calls, R0 replay, complete base restoration, commit one natural SGD, RNG advance only g0 R1.
Construct predictor by base.add(g,alpha=-eta) matching actual SGD FP32 rounding.
Capture previous raw base gradient and actual rounded committed displacement, never U or predictor displacement.
Clear history when each task optimizer/expanded head is built, preserve within task across epochs.
Add raw same-batch same-R0 post-update CE forward as a transaction around committed model; zero extra gradients, restore all committed state and R1.
Extend checkpoint and observation states with algorithm cache/layout/history-valid; hash the training state file.
Derive dedicated validator and common config/suite contract instead of editing any frozen existing queue.

minimum_config.r_and_rho: Reference metadata only: neither controls main algorithm probe distance

validator_contract: 10 complete task rows,500 epochs,2550 SGD updates; task0 500,subsequent400,400,250,200,150,150,150,200,150.
Every trace: base restored exact before SGD; predictor actual displacement matches -eta*g; update exact base.add(U,alpha=-eta); two gradient calls,one actualSGD,one observationalforward.
First step of all ten tasks history invalid; later history geometry/layout/rank/shape valid, cacherawgradient/actualdisplacement verified.
Paired methods share initialparameter/input/target/index/epochseed andLR traces; intentionally different model trajectories after first historical step.
Rawmatrix recompute FAA,AAA,BWT,LA,forgetting and hash all receipts.
Per assigned worker seeded CUDA matmul/backward witness passes physical leased UUID andpinnedruntime.
stochastic_scope: Cached prior base gradient originates previous minibatch; historical response includes minibatch/augmentation variation and is not a pure same-loss Hessian secant.
